before: A tracked row deletion created missing w:trPr/w:tcPr holders with ordinary node IDs, so rejecting it left empty holders that the imported row never had.
after: Holders that a tracked row deletion creates use mark-family node IDs. Resolving the deletion removes a holder that held only resolved markers; source holders, including empty ones, stay.
reason: The writer emits the same WordprocessingML and existing canonical primitives; only local allocation identity changes. Replicas and reopened files see ordinary holder IDs and keep an emptied holder, which is semantically equivalent and converges.
